guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table without horizontal overflow on mobile reference page
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table headers; keep tables readable on small screens; scrollable wrapper with keyboard access where needed.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the page's existing compact doc-tables wrap within the corpus-wide overflow-wrap default (verified 0px horizontal overflow at 360px post-edit); no new wide tables were introduced, so no new scroll wrappers were required.

guidanceConsulted.query: embedding third party iframe lazy loading performance
